fieldData.awb---mockup-data: window.awbMockup = { specialistReferrals: "I run scheduling for a cardiology group that gets referrals from 14 primary care practices. Build a referral form where the referring office enters the patient, attaches recent visit notes and an ECG, and marks it routine or urgent. Put urgent referrals at the top of our queue with a 2 business day booking deadline, and email the referring office the date once the visit is booked.", studentSupport: "I lead the student support team at a middle school that meets every Thursday. Build a form where teachers refer a student, name the concern and list the supports they already tried in class. Send any referral with no supports listed back to the teacher with our strategy list, and add the rest to Thursday's agenda for the counselor and the assistant principal.", employeeReferrals: "We are a trucking company that hires drivers through employee referrals. Build a form where an employee refers a friend with a resume and CDL class, and flag anyone who applied in the last 6 months. Our bonus is $1,000 once the new driver reaches 90 days. On day 90, send HR a Slack message with a button to approve the payout.", customerReferrals: "I own a home cleaning company. Give every customer a personal referral code. When a referred friend's first clean is done, take $50 off the next visit for both of them. Build me a dashboard of this quarter's referrals with how many booked, the credits issued and our top referrers, so I can thank them." };
